manifest.name: dsh-cline-pass
manifest.description: Cline Pass provider for DeepSeek Harness — fork with Russian (ru) UI locale

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node test/pin-adherence.mjs && node test/account-failover.mjs && node test/review-regressions.mjs

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch: mounts the self-contained Cline Pass provider.
#
# The row is host-plane: it registers an LLM provider route on the harness LLM
# seam (so `cline-pass/*` models appear to every agent and to the model picker)
# and registers the `cline_pass_*` management tools in the host tool registry.
#
# Defaults are ready to use: base URL https://api.cline.bot/api/v1, one route
# named `cline-pass`, and the API key read from the CLINE_PASS_API_KEY
# credential/env. Override any of it in your profile's own
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml, which is applied after every
# bundle layer:
#
# - id: cline-pass
#   config:
#     apiKeyEnv: CLINE_PASS_API_KEY
#     accounts:
#       main:
#         displayName: Main account
#         apiKeyEnv: CLINE_PASS_API_KEY
#       backup:
#         displayName: Backup account
#         apiKeyEnv: CLINE_PASS_BACKUP_KEY
#     accountMode: roundrobin

- insert:
    - id: cline-pass
      name: dsh-cline-pass

readme.text:
> ### 🇷🇺 Русская локаль (форк)
>
> Форк [yhshzh/dsh-cline-pass](https://github.com/yhshzh/dsh-cline-pass) **v0.2.14**, в который добавлен
> **русский словарь интерфейса** (`RU`) и регистрация локали `ru` в сервисе локали DSH.
>
> Штатные словари `zh` и `en` **не изменены**: если активная локаль не `ru`, панель выглядит ровно как в
> оригинале. При активной `ru` (например, вместе с плагином `dsh-locale-ru`) интерфейс карточки —
> русский.
>
> **Переведено:** панель настроек Cline Pass — аккаунты и их статусы, режим «один аккаунт / ротация»,
> поля ключей, список моделей (показать/скрыть), официальные квоты (5 часов / неделя / месяц),
> история запросов (модель, провайдер, задержка, кеш, первый токен, скорость), пиннинг каналов,
> бюджет вывода, возможности провайдера, служебные статусы и ошибки панели.
>
> **Не переведено:** комментарии в коде и часть хостовых диагностических сообщений — они остаются
> на английском, как в upstream.
>
> **Установка** (собранный пакет — в ассетах релиза, сборка не требуется):
>
> ```bash
> dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
>   https://github.com/varyda/dsh-cline-pass-ru/releases/download/v0.2.14-ru.1/dsh-cline-pass-0.2.14-ru.1.tgz
> ```
>

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

将 [Cline Pass](https://cline.bot/cline-pass) 订阅模型接入 [DeepSeek Harness（dsh）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)，直接在模型列表中使用，无需部署代理服务。

- 支持流式输出、工具调用、图片输入和推理，具体能力取决于模型。
- 多账号管理，支持单账号与轮询模式。
- 探测、校验、指定或排除上游渠道，支持首个 token 前的故障转移。
- 提供 Web 设置面板和可选的 `cline_pass_*` 管理工具。

需要 Node.js `>= 20.3.0`、dsh `>= 0.1.2-alpha.3 < 0.3.0` 和有效的 Cline Pass API Key。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cline-pass
```

安装后重启 dsh，在 **设置 → Cline Pass** 中保存并测试 API Key，然后在模型选择器中选择 Cline Pass 模型。Key 存入 dsh 凭据库，界面仅显示掩码。

也可以通过环境变量配置：

```bash
export CLINE_PASS_API_KEY="your-cline-pass-api-key"
dsh --profile web
```

以上使用 `web` profile，如需使用其他 profile，请替换对应名称。

日常配置可在 Web 面板完成。通过文件配置时，修改对应 profile 的 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`，例如：

```yaml
- id: cline-pass
  config:
    accountMode: roundrobin
    accounts:

`apiKeyEnv` 指向凭据名称或环境变量，请分别配置两个账号的 Key。管理工具默认关闭，需要时将 `exposeTools` 设为 `true`，并重启 dsh。

默认网关为 `https://api.cline.bot/api/v1`，每个账号的并发请求上限为 `16`（`maxConcurrentRequests`，`0` 表示不限）。更多选项见 [`lib/index.js`](lib/index.js)，管理工具见 [`lib/tools.js`](lib/tools.js)。

在设置面板中展开模型行，依次点击 **探测 → 校验**，保存渠道顺序或排除列表后，点击 **测试** 验证。

- `strict`：每次尝试限制到指定的候选渠道。
- `preferred`：向网关传递渠道偏好顺序，必要时尝试后续候选渠道。

校验会向每个渠道发送真实请求，不会修改已保存的规则；可重试的故障转移发生在首个 token 输出前。

项目使用 JavaScript ES Modules，无需编译。安装依赖后运行：

```bash
npm install
npm test
npm run test:client
npm run test:mount

测试需要兼容版本的 dsh 相关包，挂载测试还需要完整的 dsh 安装。`npm run test:live`、`npm run test:live:image` 和 `npm run test:live:reasoning` 会访问真实网关，需要有效 Key 并消耗额度或产生费用。

欢迎提交 [Issue](https://github.com/yhshzh/dsh-cline-pass/issues) 或 Pull Request。报告问题时请附版本、复现步骤及脱敏日志；提交代码前请运行相关测试。
上游渠道和故障转移行为参考了 MIT 许可的 [`cline-pass-switcher`](https://github.com/munmunjaklin458-afk/cline-pass-switcher)。

[中文](README.md) | English

Use [Cline Pass](https://cline.bot/cline-pass) subscription models directly in [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai), without running a separate proxy service.

- Streaming, tool calls, image input, and reasoning, depending on the model.
- Multiple accounts with single-account and round-robin modes.
- Discover, validate, pin, or exclude upstream channels, with failover before the first token.
- Web settings panel and optional `cline_pass_*` management tools.

Requires Node.js `>= 20.3.0`, dsh `>= 0.1.2-alpha.3 < 0.3.0`, and a valid Cline Pass API key.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cline-pass
```

Restart dsh, open **Settings → Cline Pass** to save and test your API key, then select a Cline Pass model in the model picker. Keys are stored in the dsh credential store and displayed only in masked form.

Alternatively, configure the key through an environment variable:

```bash
export CLINE_PASS_API_KEY="your-cline-pass-api-key"
dsh --profile web
```

These commands use the `web` profile; replace the name if you use another profile.

Use the Web panel for everyday configuration. For file-based configuration, edit your profile's `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`, for example:

```yaml
- id: cline-pass
  config:
    accountMode: roundrobin
    accounts:

Each `apiKeyEnv` refers to a credential name or environment variable; configure a key for each account. Management tools are disabled by default. Set `exposeTools` to `true` and restart dsh to enable them.

The default gateway is `https://api.cline.bot/api/v1`. Each account allows up to `16` concurrent requests (`maxConcurrentRequests`; `0` removes the limit). See [`lib/index.js`](lib/index.js) for more options and [`lib/tools.js`](lib/tools.js) for management tools.

Expand a model row in the settings panel, click **Probe → Validate**, save your channel order or exclusions, then click **Test** to verify.

- `strict`: Restrict each attempt to its specified candidate channel.
- `preferred`: Send a preferred channel order to the gateway and try subsequent candidates when needed.

Validation sends real requests to each channel without changing saved rules. Failover for retryable errors takes place before the first output token.

The project uses JavaScript ES Modules with no build step. Install dependencies and run:

```bash
npm install
npm test
npm run test:client
npm run test:mount

Tests require compatible dsh packages; the mount test also requires a complete dsh installation. `npm run test:live`, `npm run test:live:image`, and `npm run test:live:reasoning` access the live gateway, require a valid key, and consume quota or incur charges.

[Issues](https://github.com/yhshzh/dsh-cline-pass/issues) and Pull Requests are welcome. Include versions, reproduction steps, and sanitized logs in bug reports, and run relevant tests before submitting code.
Upstream channel and failover behavior was informed by the MIT-licensed [`cline-pass-switcher`](https://github.com/munmunjaklin458-afk/cline-pass-switcher).
